# Where to find and how to farm for Nuka-Cola Twist in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 25, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Dec 4, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_64e829acbcd843b9892cc48612d94197~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Used For:__

- Daily Challenge: Consume Nuka Cola Twist
- Weekly Challenge: Consume Nuka Cola Twist
- 2022 Nuka World Challenge: Consume Nuka Cola Twist
- Leo Petrov: Nuka-Inspiration: Nuka Cola Twist = +2 Luck for 60 mins
- XP Farming - +2 Intelligence

__X Can Drop the Following Items:__

Nuka Cola Twist is not dropped by any creatures or NPCs.

__Farming Tips and Tricks:__

There are no perk cards, magazines, or backpack mods that will increase your yields for Nuka Cola Twist.

__Vendors and Camp Allies:__

**Nuka World on Tour Mixer Machines:** 33% chance to spawn.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5adaea241a28465aba293a086715db26~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn location, turn West and head toward the large red bottle behind Wild West Showdown (Cappy's Nuka-Cade).

Follow the path to Pete Myers on the picnic bench on your left. Turn SW to find the Mixer Machines at the end of the path.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9a4be4b71a6043778c4e3629cdc7fedf~mv2.jpg)

__Containers and Collectrons:__

40.50% chance for Nuka Cola Twist.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ea117d603fe7428fb5474cf79269f93b~mv2.png)

Nuka-Cola Quantum Collectron Station:

9.31% chance for Nuka Cola Twist.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0591f1eef83447cdb70084588ab4d87e~mv2.png)

__Perk Cards:__

To maximize the effects of Nuka Cola Twist, equip the Cola Nut perk under Endurance:

- At Rank 1, you can stack Nuka Cola Twist effects by consuming up to two bottles, granting two separate +2 buffs to random S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats. The buffs cannot affect the same stat simultaneously, ensuring two unique bonuses.
- At Rank 2, you can stack Nuka Cola Twist effects by consuming up to three bottles, granting three separate +2 buffs to random S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats. The buffs cannot affect the same stat simultaneously, ensuring three unique bonuses.
